subject: flight-system
q: CLOSED — Cyrena, Zephinia, Morrighan and Hela. All four from nomadic tribes.
detail:
MORRIGHAN is the fourth. The Archive's two range-arithmetic candidates — Zephi at 01-211 and Ceri at 01-203 — were both correct, and the one it could never have found is the one whose number is unrecorded. Which is the argument for flagging inferences instead of filing them: the method got two out of three and would have closed the question wrong.

All four came out of NOMADIC TRIBES — Wallachian, Germanic Visigoth, cultic druid, and Scottish Pict. Morrighan's and Hela's flight numbers are still unrecorded.
